personal.name: Sravya Varada
personal.title: AI Engineer
personal.summary: Computer Science undergraduate at BITS Pilani with hands-on experience building Python-based AI backends, REST API integrations, and customer-facing data pipelines. Delivered a production RAG system automating 1,000+ MCQ generations for a national education platform. Comfortable across the full stack from SQL/NoSQL data modelling to Python backend services.

highlights: Built a RAG pipeline using OpenAI API and ChromaDB backed by a PostgreSQL question bank, automating generation of 1,000+ MCQs and cutting manual content creation time by 70%.
Developed and maintained Python backend services exposing REST API endpoints consumed by the web platform.
Analysed user engagement data across 15% of the active user base to uncover behavioural trends.
Designed and shipped an interactive financial literacy game used across outreach campaigns.
Maintained codebase on GitHub using a PR-based workflow, participating in code reviews.
